project.name: ClapControl IoT
project.context: ESP32 local web dashboard for lamp relay control and KY-037 sound monitoring
project.runtime: PlatformIO Arduino on ESP32 DevKit V1
constraints: Embed HTML, CSS, and JavaScript directly in src/main.cpp

motionPaletteDecision.motionDensitySource: Embedded device dashboard with high-frequency sensor refresh
motionPaletteDecision.paletteAutopilotRisk: Avoid generic dark dashboard by deriving colors from electrical status roles
motionPaletteDecision.threeDimensionalOrCanvasUse: Unnecessary for relay control and ESP32-hosted UI

conceptualAnchor.rationale: The product needs immediate relay status, live numeric sensor feedback, and precise threshold tuning.
conceptualAnchor.signatureMotion: Analog meter fill eases toward the live sound value while relay status glow changes immediately.
conceptualAnchor.typographicDecision: Large numeric sensor value contrasts with compact uppercase labels for instrument-like scanning.

derivedTokenLogic.colorDerivationSource: Green, red, and yellow electrical signal roles from the multimeter-style anchor
derivedTokenLogic.spacingDerivationSource: Grouped control zones similar to meter display, mode, and input areas
derivedTokenLogic.typographyDerivationSource: Numeric display prominence with compact metadata labels
derivedTokenLogic.motionDerivationSource: Fast instrument feedback with restrained smoothing

conceptualAnchor.visualRiskBudget: Low: no external assets and no memory-heavy canvas
cohesionChecks: Status is visible without relying on color alone
Threshold control stays near the sensor readout
Mobile layout promotes immediate lamp actions

derivedTokenLogic.colorDerivationSource: Electrical signal semantics for on, off, warning, and panel contrast
derivedTokenLogic.spacingDerivationSource: Instrument zones separated by card panels and compact gaps
derivedTokenLogic.typographyDerivationSource: Large display digits paired with concise control labels
derivedTokenLogic.motionDerivationSource: Immediate relay feedback and eased sensor meter response
derivedTokenLogic.validationRule: Every visual token must support quick relay control or sensor readability.

libraryDecisions.name: Native CSS and browser fetch API
libraryDecisions.purpose: Serve a dependency-free dashboard from ESP32 flash
libraryDecisions.risk: Browser support is broad for local network use
libraryDecisions.fallbackIfUnavailable: Basic HTML controls still call the JSON endpoints

responsiveMutation.mobile: Stack hero, controls, threshold, then metadata; full-width control buttons
responsiveMutation.tablet: Single-column or narrow two-zone layout depending on viewport width
responsiveMutation.desktop: Two-column instrument layout with status overview beside control panel

repoEvidence.designEvidenceSummary: Existing repo is a PlatformIO ESP32 scaffold with placeholder main.cpp and no docs directory.
